laws.rule: Nanjing: setting off fireworks is banned in the central urban districts and listed neighbourhoods named in article 3. Fireworks may not be carried into hotels, restaurants and other public places or onto public transport, or hidden in luggage or mail (article 8). Penalties follow the State Council's Fireworks Safety Management Regulation (article 10).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine amount not stated in the Nanjing rule; it refers to the State Council regulation.

laws.rule: Electric bicycle riders and passengers must wear a safety helmet (article 41).
laws.penalty_signal: Warning or CNY 20 to 50 (about A$4.27 to A$10.67). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
